CONDUCTION IN HETEROGENEOUS MEDIA.
[318.
Then, by Article 315, we have from the conditions for the
surface through $A$,
$$I=\frac{k_{2}-k_{1}}{k_{2}+k_{1}} E, \quad E^{\prime}=\frac{2 k_{2}}{k_{2}+k_{1}} E$$
(11)
For the surface through $B$ we find
$$I_{1}^{\prime}=\frac{k_{3}-k_{2}}{k_{3}+k_{2}} E^{\prime \prime}, \quad E^{\prime \prime}=\frac{2 k_{3}}{k_{2}+k_{3}} E^{\prime}$$
(12)
Similarly for the surface through $A$ again,
$$J_{1}^{\prime}=\frac{k_{1}-k_{2}}{k_{1}+k_{2}} I_{1}^{\prime}, \quad I_{1}=\frac{2 k_{1}}{k_{1}+k_{2}} I_{1}^{\prime}$$
(13)
and for the surface through $B$,
$$I_{2}^{\prime}=\frac{k_{3}-k_{2}}{k_{3}+k_{2}} J_{1}^{\prime}, \quad J_{1}=\frac{2 k_{3}}{k_{3}+k_{2}} J_{1}^{\prime}$$
(14)
If we make $\quad \rho=\frac{k_{1}-k_{2}}{k_{1}+k_{2}}$ and $\rho^{\prime}=\frac{k_{3}-k_{2}}{k_{3}+k_{2}}$,
we find for the potential in the first medium,
$$\begin{aligned}
& V=\frac{E}{P S}-\rho \frac{E}{P I}+\left(1-\rho^{2}\right) \rho^{\prime} \frac{E}{P I_{1}}+\rho^{\prime}\left(1-\rho^{2}\right) \rho \rho^{\prime} \frac{E}{P I_{2}}+\text { \&c. } \\
&+\rho^{\prime}\left(1-\rho^{2}\right)\left(\rho \rho^{\prime}\right)^{n-1} \frac{E}{P I_{n}}+\ldots .
\end{aligned}$$
(15)
For the potential in the third medium we find
$$V=\left(1+\rho^{\prime}\right)(1-\rho) E\left\{\frac{1}{P S}+\frac{\rho \rho^{\prime}}{P J_{1}}+\text { \&c. }+\frac{\left(\rho \rho^{\prime}\right)^{n}}{P J_{n}}+\ldots\right\}^{*}$$
(16)
* \{These expressions may be reduced to definite integrals by the relation
$$\frac{1}{\sqrt{a^{3}+b^{2}}}=\int_{0}^{\infty} J_{0}(b t) e^{-a t} d t$$
where $J_{0}$ denotes Bessel's function of zero order.
Hence if we take $S$ as the origin of coordinates, and the normal to the plate as
the axis of $x$,
$$\begin{aligned}
\frac{1}{P S} & =\int_{0}^{\infty} J_{0}(y t) e^{-x t} d t \\
\frac{1}{P J_{1}} & =\int_{0}^{\infty} J_{0}(y t) e^{-(x+2 c) t} d t
\end{aligned}$$
where $c$ is the thickness of the plate,
$$\frac{1}{P J_{2}}=\int_{0}^{\infty} J_{0}(y t) e^{-(x+4 c) t} d t$$
and so on. Substituting these values in (16), we see that $V$ equals
$$E\left(1+\rho^{\prime}\right)(1-\rho) \int_{0}^{\infty} \frac{J_{0}(y t) e^{-x t}}{1-\rho \rho^{\prime} e^{-2 c t}} d t$$
The values of this when $y=0, x=2 \dot{n} c$ when $n$ is an integer can easily be found. \}
